userStories.title: ADR: apps are fabric producers via a thin adapter; grounding reuses same_as (not mentions)
userStories.description: Record the ecosystem-architecture decision as a koine ADR (decisions/): a THIN adapter (cuneiform-rendered, or hand-written for any A2A/MCP app) makes an app a fabric PRODUCER by emitting koine contracts — KGP knowledge claims (ADR-0006 + the relation registry), KMI media refs, a KFT training-exhaust dataset (by reference), and a KCB capability manifest — while agora implements the generic data-plane bridges. Per-app bridge/projection code (Argos bridge/, core/projections.py) is SUPERSEDED, consistent with media-interchange.md withdrawing the skill_export_* projection family and identity.md making entity-merge a query-time view. DECISION (locked by the owner): entity grounding reuses `same_as` + the query-time merge VIEW (identity.md §4); NO new `mentions` relation is added — a mention->canonical assertion is a source-local-id `same_as`, merged at query time. The ADR states this rationale.
acceptanceCriteria: A new decisions/ADR records the fabric-producer-adapter pattern (app emits KGP/KMI/KFT/KCB; agora bridges the data planes; per-app projection code superseded) and the same_as-not-mentions grounding decision, cross-referencing ADR-0006, identity.md §4, fine-tuning.md §4, grounding-pack.md, and media-interchange.md's withdrawn projection family.

registry/relations.tsv is confirmed to carry same_as (grounding) + derived_from (lineage) with the needed semantics — no new relation added; a doc-only annotation is fine. ECOSYSTEM.md (or README) gains a short 'fabric producer' note pointing at the ADR.
Verify passes (schemas parse; same_as + derived_from present).

userStories.title: Confirm (or port) the KFT training-exhaust dataset contract via a scenario
userStories.description: Confirm the KFT training-DATASET contract (fine-tuning.md §4: training data BY REFERENCE — KGP/KMI refs — plus the dataset-jsonl-header schema and the egress/license/trust gate) supports an app emitting its 'training exhaust' (a run's accepted records as training examples). If the dataset-jsonl-header (and/or finetune-job.schema.json) is not yet in schemas/, port it from fine-tuning.md's normative text. Then add a scenarios/ pressure-test walking: an app marks accepted records -> emits a by-reference KFT dataset with a dataset-jsonl-header -> agora's KFT bridge admits it under the egress/license gate -> a lugh finetune job consumes it. If the header lacks a field the exhaust needs (e.g. per-record source/provenance ref), add it minimally and note it in fine-tuning.md; else confirm reuse verbatim. Reference: Argos bridge/dataset_export.py at tag fabric-reference for the record shape.
acceptanceCriteria: The dataset-jsonl-header + finetune-job schemas exist in schemas/ (ported from fine-tuning.md if absent) and are confirmed sufficient for the training-exhaust use case — by-reference only, never inlined training data (§4).

A scenarios/ file demonstrates the app-exhaust -> KFT-by-reference -> lugh admission flow, replayable per koine's scenario convention, citing the header + finetune-job schema and the egress/license gate.
